result.title: Actually, All Learnable Distribution Classes Are Privately Learnable
result.summary: We show that every class of distributions that is learnable up to arbitrarily small target error in total variation distance with finitely many samples is also learnable under ($\varepsilon, δ$)-differential privacy up to arbitrarily small target error with finitely many samples. This proves a conjecture of Ashtiani. Previous work by Bun, Kamath, Mouzakis, and Singhal [arXiv:2402.00267] gave a weak refutation of this conjecture, showing that this implication is not true when learnability is defined with respect to a fixed target error. In contrast, we show that, under the standard definition of learnability, the conjecture is true.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文证明一个统计学习理论结论：任何在总变差距离下可用有限样本学习到任意小误差的分布类，也可在 (ε, δ)-差分隐私约束下学习，从而正面解决 Ashtiani 的猜想。
AI.relevance_reason: 这是分布学习的隐私可学性理论研究，与视觉多模态推理中的表示、生成、停止决策等主线无实质联系，也未提供可迁移的 latent 状态或训练监督线索。
